name: LiCONiC STX44 incubator
status_line: In PyLabRobot legacy only (v0); STX44_IC is a listed model (pylabrobot/legacy/storage/liconic/constants.py:5). ASCII over RS-232.
reaches: RS-232, 9600 baud 8E1, RTS/CTS (pylabrobot/legacy/storage/liconic/liconic_backend.py:80-90). Host speaks first: a break, CR answered by CC, then 1 ASCII command per line (ST, RS, RD, WR DMn) ending in CR; replies end CR LF (pylabrobot/legacy/storage/liconic/liconic_backend.py:96-139).
decoded_from: Upstream points to LiCONiC documentation: tests check 2 reference points from the Liconic documentation (pylabrobot/legacy/storage/liconic/liconic_backend_tests.py:52-55), and a TODO says a shaker command must still be found there (pylabrobot/legacy/storage/liconic/liconic_backend.py:369). Many methods are marked UNTESTED (pylabrobot/legacy/storage/liconic/liconic_backend.py:365-554).
steps: Connect the STX PLC by RS-232. The backend opens it at 9600 baud 8E1 with RTS/CTS (pylabrobot/legacy/storage/liconic/liconic_backend.py:80-90).
Create ExperimentalLiconicBackend(model="STX44_IC", port="/dev/ttyUSB0"); models are listed in pylabrobot/legacy/storage/liconic/constants.py:5-63.
Build Incubator(backend, racks=[...], ...) with liconic_rack_* racks matching the cassettes; cassette numbers follow the rack order (pylabrobot/legacy/storage/liconic/liconic_backend.py:141-147).
await stx.setup(): break, CR -> CC, ST 1801 -> OK, then RD 1915 until 1 (pylabrobot/legacy/storage/liconic/liconic_backend.py:96-139).

Put the plate on stx.loading_tray, then take_in_plate(site), fetch_plate_to_loading_tray(name), get_temperature() (pylabrobot/legacy/storage/incubator.py:111 and pylabrobot/legacy/storage/incubator.py:151-177).
Watch the shovel by eye on the first runs and file the upstream device test report (docs/user_guide/needs-testing.md:31-35).
scenario: Take 1 plate from the transfer station into cassette 1, position 1, fetch it back out to the transfer station, then read the temperature. Made-up slot and a made-up 37.0 deg C.
real: Legacy upstream ExperimentalLiconicBackend and Incubator, unchanged
Every command string the backend writes, e.g. WR DM23 788, ST 1904
Error codes and messages, e.g. 00103 import lift transfer error
simulated: The STX44 PLC: parsing, CC/OK/1 replies, registers DM0 DM5 DM23 DM25
Plate location: transfer station, shovel, cassette slot; temperature
Faults: dropped reply to ST 1904; handler error 00103 on the shovel
not_checked: Any physical STX44; nothing here ran on hardware
Reply to WR and most ST commands assumed OK (TODO_1)
Real move times and plate position after a fault (TODO_2)
limits: Shaker, CO2, N2, swap station and sensor methods are marked UNTESTED; shaker_status raises NotImplementedError (pylabrobot/legacy/storage/liconic/liconic_backend.py:365-370 and pylabrobot/legacy/storage/liconic/liconic_backend.py:448-554).
A handling fault surfaces only after the 60 s ready poll times out, then RD 1814 and RD DM200 (pylabrobot/legacy/storage/liconic/liconic_backend.py:319-339).

The 104 mm rack step size 3563 does not fit the formula the tests use (pitch x 1713 / 50 gives 3769); a TODO says verify with hardware (pylabrobot/legacy/storage/liconic/liconic_backend_tests.py:42-50).

No non-legacy LiCONiC driver at this commit (docs/_static/devices.json:842-856, v0). The guide wants 1 plain class, Literal not enums, an untested warning (docs/contributor_guide/device-driver-guide.md:17 and docs/contributor_guide/device-driver-guide.md:25 and docs/contributor_guide/device-driver-guide.md:47).
